summary.text: Guul Draz is a boiling, sulfurous region of Zendikar, the home of proud and deadly vampire families.

bio.text: Pages describe it as the vampire continent being devoured by the Eldrazi and as the home of vampires who raid the coast of Tazeem.
Across Zendikar, the surviving Zendikari adapt and build alliances among kor, merfolk, elves, humans and vampire families.

status.text: The only recorded event is the Zendikari building alliances that include the vampire families, and later pages mention Guul Draz as a region where Tazri hunts a beast and Tarsa's party operates.
